target_note: Source labels have different horizons and event definitions. The calibrated output is an educational adverse-credit-outcome probability, not a common-horizon regulatory PD.
evaluation_scope: Seeded random within-source interpolation. No leave-one-source-out, unseen-country or out-of-time generalization claim is made.
currency_note: Only currencies disclosed by their source are converted to INR at fixed rates (TWD 2.97, USD 83). Home Credit's currency and geography are undisclosed, so its monetary fields are not converted or used as INR values. FX conversion is presentation localization, not Indian evidence.
